_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The active recorder keeps floating while an archived conversation is viewed. The test seeded the conversation at /c/{{ORIGINAL_SLUG}}, and archived another conversation {{ARCHIVED}} at /c/{{ARCHIVED_SLUG}}. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". The recorder "floats" while the recording panel is inside a [data-testid="recording-floating"] element: count '[data-testid="recording-floating"] [data-testid="recording-panel"]' (1 when floating, 0 when not). Recording uploads are counted by call "uploads". The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /c/{{ORIGINAL_SLUG}} and wait up to 30s for the message input to be visible.
2. Click the voice button. The recording panel should be visible. Mark it: eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"recording-panel\"]').setAttribute('data-instance-marker', 'archived')".
3. If the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it. Click the button "View Archived", then click ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"{{ARCHIVED}}\"]".
4. The URL should have exactly the path "/c/{{ARCHIVED_SLUG}}" (an exact "value", not "text"), and the message input should be hidden.
5. Exactly one recording panel should exist (count 1); it should be visible and still have data-instance-marker "archived", the recorder should float, and [data-testid="recording-return-button"] should be visible.
6. Click [data-testid="recording-return-button"]. The URL should have exactly the path "/c/{{ORIGINAL_SLUG}}" (an exact "value", not "text"), and the recorder should not float.
7. Click the cancel button. Call "uploads" must return "0".
